prompt: Typing a comment on an issue fires a request to the activity endpoint on every keystroke.

truth.summary: IssueDetailPage passes ActivityLog an inline types array. useActivity lists it as an effect dependency, and the comment draft lives in the page state, so each keystroke re-renders the page with a new array and the effect refetches.

referenceAnswer.cause: IssueDetailPage passes a new inline types array on every render, and useActivity's effect depends on it, so each keystroke in the page-level comment draft refetches activity.

decoyAnswers.cause: The effect has no cleanup, so requests pile up.

genieEvidence.notes: react_effect_audit reports the useActivity effect (use-activity.ts) re-running once per keystroke with lastChangedDep 1 (types) and labels it hot: every re-run changed only the identity of an equal array. The timeline request lane shows one /activity request per keystroke. Request URLs drop the query string (?types=...).
